rationale: No supported optimization can be safely applied. The only measured evidence (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, experiment batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) requires representative successful-duration history as a precondition, but ci_history shows no completed runs, so a safe timeout budget cannot be derived. The E2E jobs are long-running (Cypress plus Erigon/Anvil setup), so imposing a fixed timeout without baseline data risks false timeouts and would weaken coverage. The workflow already caches pnpm dependencies via setup-node cache, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is largely already in place. Other patterns do not fit: no matrix exists for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, no Bazel build for the Bazel patterns, no scheduled workflows for P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE/P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE, and change-filtering or test-selection patterns could compromise E2E coverage since many file types can affect the dApp.
